price.basis: regular price; $1,899 is a Black Friday sale

price.quote: The 2024 Unio E20 will be available in black or red. Pricing hasn't been revealed at this time, though the current model costs US$2,699.

spd.quote: A proprietary 200-W mid-drive motor offers five pedal-assist levels up to 32 km/h (20 mph) via a central-axis torque sensor

wh.quote: The 36-V/9.5-Ah (342-Wh) seat-tube battery is made up of Samsung Li-ion cells

range.quote: 36V9.5AH Seatpost Battery, Up to 100km Pedal Assist Range
is reckoned good for up to 100 km (62 miles) of per-charge riding at the lowest assist level.

wt.quote: it weighs in at 18.7 kg (41 lb)

motor.quote: Dahon 36V/200W Mid-Motor 36V 9.5AH seat tube Battery Samsung Cell ⟶ Drivetrain
A proprietary 200-W mid-drive motor offers five pedal-assist levels

fold.quote: The upcoming model is built around an aluminum alloy frame with a ViseGrip hinge that allows it to fold down
